digest.component_or_area: CLI command dispatcher and bridge subcommand group
propositions: Three top-level CLI verbs (bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard) are being renamed and nested under a new bridge noun group as (bridge fsck, bridge check-access, bridge setup)
Old verb names must remain as functional compatibility entrypoints routing to identical implementations without behavioral changes
All in-tree consumers—CLI dispatchers, test files, help text, docs, workflows, and scripts—must be migrated to canonical noun-based spellings while preserving backward compatibility
String-literal references in tests (monkeypatch targets, assertions) and documentation must be systematically searched and updated alongside symbol-level migrations

The three renamings are existing functionality migrations, not new implementations; bridge setup calls bridge check-access as final validation with the same overlay behavior and --no-validate escape hatch already present
